name: hud
description: A heads-up display for the session: the questions Claude asked that you haven't answered, one-line answers to the questions you asked, every link and file it handed you, what is still running, heads-ups and the next step. A small model reads each finished turn. /hud opens the pane.

model.title: Reader model
model.description: The model that reads each finished turn to fill the HUD: an alias (haiku) or a full model id.

autoOpen.title: Open on first item
autoOpen.description: Open the pane by itself when the HUD first has something to show (wide terminals only).

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Show the short HUD band above the prompt. Off leaves the /hud pane only.

motion.title: Banner motion
motion.description: When the pane's banner moves: always, working (only while Claude works or a turn is read) or off.
